svg.title: From the car to the intake
svg.desc: On the 2010 2.9, combustion air enters through the left side opening and reaches the engine behind the seats. The two banks receive air through the intake above them. Follow air from the side opening through filtration, measurement and the throttle. The controller separately commands the port injectors and individual ignition coils. Numbered parts: 1 Left side inlet; 2 Air cleaner; 3 Air-mass sensor; 4 Electronic throttle; 5 Plenums + runners; 6 Ports + injectors; 7 Coils + plugs; 8 DME controller. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
